definitions.explanation: The number fifty. Formed by combining {五|ご} (five) and {十|じゅう} (ten), literally meaning 'five tens.'

examples.english: My grandfather built this house fifty years ago.

examples.japanese: {五十|ごじゅう}⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まりました→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
⟦{五十音|ごじゅうおん}→五十音：15489_gojuuon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}えましょう→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧。
examples.english: Let's learn the fifty sounds (Japanese syllabary).
You can buy it for fifty yen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧{五十|ごじゅう}⟦{歳|さい}→歳：10017_sai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦お{祝|いわ}い→祝い：01838_iwai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}います→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: My father will turn fifty next year, so we want to celebrate as a family.

notes:
{五十|ごじゅう} is the number fifty, formed from ⟦{五|ご}→五：00697_go⟧ (five) + ⟦{十|じゅう}→十：00708_juu⟧ (ten).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{五十音|ごじゅうおん}→五十音：15489_gojuuon⟧: the Japanese syllabary system (literally 'fifty sounds'), though the actual number of sounds differs
- ⟦{五十音|ごじゅうおん}→五十音：15489_gojuuon⟧⟦{順|じゅん}→順：03342_jun⟧: Japanese alphabetical order (the equivalent of ABC order)
- {五十|ごじゅう}⟦{歩|ぽ}→歩：00108_ho⟧⟦{百|ひゃっ}→百：00780_hyaku⟧⟦{歩|ぽ}→歩：00108_ho⟧: six of one, half a dozen of the other (proverb)

USAGE:
{五十|ごじゅう} follows standard Japanese number formation. For counting objects, combine with the appropriate counter: {五十|ごじゅう}⟦{個|こ}→〜個：00645_ko⟧ (50 items), {五十|ごじゅう}⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧ (50 people), {五十|ごじゅう}⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧ (50 yen).
